nestedSelection.note: Variants selected by pooled weighted all-pair loss on earlier completed validation blocks; the first block has no earlier selection evidence.

protocol.calibration: Expanding seasons from 2002 through the year preceding each validation block.
protocol.candidateSelection: The initial ablations were fixed before scoring; unified candidates were added after observing those results. Historical seasons informed prior model development and are not untouched holdouts.
protocol.weighting: Exam observation weights; pooled across race and qualifying observations. Differences are candidate minus control.
protocol.uncertainty: Paired percentile bootstrap: seasons for pair forecasts, driver moves for frozen mover forecasts; 300 replicates.
protocol.frozen: Driver rating before final old-team weekend; teammate rating at same time, field opponent and cars before each new-team weekend.
